sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Loading a file from disk on a page that had already been rendered used to quietly throw away the heading this script adds above the table and build a replacement. Nothing looked wrong afterwards — the replacement landed in the same place — but anything attached to the original heading went with it. The heading is now left alone, which is what the code always intended.

This changes nothing you can see. It is recorded because the page was only coming out right by accident: a later clean-up step happened to remove the leftover, and that had never been written down or tested anywhere.
